record: item id N = record N - 1 of every shop list; records 12 to 93 are eight zero bytes
type_byte: itemType = byte >> 3 (lab: 1 melee, 2 ranged, 3 ammo, 4 armour, 5 medical, 6 tool, 7 quest, 8 burst); lowFlags = 0
damage_byte: melee, ranged, burst, medical: high nibble = dice count, low nibble = die sides; armour: AC bonus
